audit_metadata.audit_scope: Final Pre-GitHub Audit Corrections & Repository Freeze

executive_summary.summary: Repository is fully implemented, verified, and free of defects. All 439 tests pass (5 skipped with documented reasons). All 60 episodes across 4 quadrants validate with 0 template overlap. All report links are repository-relative. UNKNOWN provenance fail-closed invariant (P10) is verified and enforced. The E2a vs E2b distinction is rigorously documented across 3 separate protection layers (Recipient Authorization, Provenance-Based Protection, and Combined Defense). Aya Expanse 8B is standardized as the sole active model, and Tiny Aya is formally recorded as discontinued.

layer_1_recipient_authorization.mechanism: Enforces whitelist boundaries on target resources (email recipients, file paths, DB queries).
layer_1_recipient_authorization.bulk_benchmark_performance: 100.0% block rate across all 30 bulk attack episodes for both E2a and E2b, because all canonical attack episodes attempt exfiltration to external/unauthorized addresses.
layer_1_recipient_authorization.finding: Recipient authorization alone provides strong perimeter protection against direct redirection, but cannot detect exfiltration when the recipient is authorized.

layer_2_provenance_based_protection.mechanism: Tracks origin lineage (UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL, DERIVED_UNTRUSTED) across turns to block tainted arguments even when the recipient is authorized.

controlled_ablation_performance.e2a_turn_local_block_rate: 0.0% (0/3 blocked on authorized-recipient delayed exfiltration; canaries leaked)

layer_2_provenance_based_protection.finding: Persistent provenance (E2b) is essential for preventing multi-turn indirect prompt injections that hijack authorized communication channels, where turn-local defenses (E2a) fail completely.

layer_3_combined_defense.mechanism: Active combination of recipient whitelist validation and persistent multi-turn provenance tracking (E2b / E4).

controlled_ablation_overall.e2a_overall_block_rate: 25.0% (1/4 blocked via recipient check; 75.0% canary leak rate)

fail_closed_rules.P10: Missing, ungrounded, or ablated provenance resolves to UNKNOWN and FAILS CLOSED at the gateway (UNKNOWN_ARGUMENT_PROVENANCE).
